verdict.rationale: Simular documents its own hosted Windows or Linux cloud computers as an alternative to the user's own Mac or Windows PC. Developers can drive these through the Sai API, Python SDK or MCP server, so the agent can run on an isolated VM before being pointed at a real device. However, the docs never describe these VMs as sandboxes, ephemeral or resettable environments, or a test-then-promote workflow, and setup and logins are said to persist between sessions. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/isolation guarantees, container support, snapshot/reset of test environments, a documented staging-to-BYOD promotion flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
